'''2009 2K Event Day 1 Joe Giannetti DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Giannetti]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
